text: Highly recommend! The doctor and everyone at the clinic are very kind and helped relieve my anxiety. The wisdom tooth extraction was painless. The clinic is clean and the air conditioning is cool.
Very friendly and professional clinic. They helped me quickly and made everything easy. Thank you!

If you're driving, finding parking can be difficult.
The wait is long, even with an appointment, you'll often be delayed.
But the dentist is excellent. If you can overlook the parking and waiting times, it's a good option for a dental clinic.

The dentist explained everything in detail before starting the procedure. He was very gentle and did a better job than anywhere else I've been. He gave further detailed instructions afterward.
Excellent!

My wife who is Thai ( I am Australian ) has just come back to our hotel room bright smile beaming after visiting this dental surgery for the first time . From the initial impressions from the lovely reception staff who advised all the required information at first contact . Then the doctors and nurses who were very considerate but at the same time also very professional . Special mention to Dr Khun ! Thank you and all your excellent staff !

She got a check up and X-Ray , Clean and 2 fillings for an extremely fair price in a very modern surgery . We have recently gotten implants in another country where it felt like a production line whereas  Dr Khun’s staff all were caring , knowledgeable and lovely and always asking if my wife was ok .

We will definitely be back for more standard dental work and we are now even looking at a bit more complicated surgery in the future . This was also quoted on at some very competitive pricing while she was there.

On top of all that did I mention how convenient it is to the Victory Monument BTS station ? Get a picture then get your teeth cleaned and checked !
Dentists and staff are happy to serve you. 😊😊 …
